style: Style: an original illustration in the manner of a traditional Chinese gongbi ink-and-colour painting on aged parchment. Head-and-shoulders bust, three-quarter view, centred, facing slightly left. Muted earthy palette (ochre, rust red, indigo, sage green, sepia ink outlines), soft paper grain. Plain warm parchment background fading to the edges, no scenery. Late Eastern Han dynasty (2nd century AD) clothing and hairstyles, historically plausible. Dignified, painterly, not photorealistic, not anime, not a video-game character. No text, no letters, no seals, no signature, no border.

items.zhangjiao: Zhang Jiao, leader of the Yellow Turban rebellion, a gaunt Taoist faith healer in his forties with a thin dark beard and intense, fervent eyes, wearing a yellow cloth headband and a plain yellow-brown hemp robe, holding a small bowl of charmed water.
items.liubei: Liu Bei at 23, a gentle, calm young man of modest means with a clean-shaven face, a short neat moustache, unusually long earlobes and kind eyes; hair in a simple topknot with a cloth band, wearing a worn undyed hemp robe of a straw-sandal seller; a quiet, sincere expression.
items.zhangfei: Zhang Fei, a young butcher, broad and powerful, with a round leopard-like head, big round glaring eyes and a bristling black beard like a tiger's whiskers; dark tanned skin, hair tied up roughly, a coarse dark sleeveless tunic showing strong shoulders; loud, fierce, energetic expression.
items.guanyu: Guan Yu as a young fugitive, very tall, with a deep red face the colour of a ripe jujube, long narrow phoenix eyes, thick silkworm eyebrows and a long flowing black beard reaching his chest; hair in a topknot under a dark green cloth headwrap, wearing a plain green robe; stern, calm and proud.
items.caocao: Cao Cao at about thirty, a short, slight young officer with sharp, shrewd narrow eyes, a thin moustache and a small goatee, wearing a black Han official cap and a dark crimson-and-black robe; confident, with the hint of a sly smile.
items.huangfusong: Huangfu Song, a veteran imperial Han general in his fifties, wearing lacquered lamellar armour over a red robe, a grey-streaked beard, weathered stern and dignified face.
items.seer: Xu Shao, a famous elderly judge of character, an old scholar with a long white beard, a simple black scholar cap and a plain grey robe, a calm, knowing, slightly amused gaze.
items.hejin: He Jin, the Grand General, a heavyset middle-aged man who was once a butcher, with a full black beard and a ruddy face, wearing a rich dark-red official robe and a tall black official cap; proud and pompous.
items.zhangrang: Zhang Rang, the chief palace eunuch, an older man with a smooth beardless face and thin lips, wearing a tall black court cap with a small gold plaque and a sable-tail ornament, a rich crimson court robe; cunning, calculating eyes.
items.dongzhuo: Dong Zhuo, a huge corpulent frontier warlord of about fifty from the north-west, with heavy jowls, a thick bristly black beard, small cruel eyes, fur-trimmed armour over a dark robe; arrogant, menacing smile.
items.lvbu: Lu Bu, a tall, handsome young warrior in ornate bronze-and-red armour, wearing a gold headdress with two long pheasant tail feathers, the shaft of a halberd over his shoulder; fierce, proud, restless gaze.
items.dingyuan: Ding Yuan, an upright middle-aged provincial inspector, with a neat black beard, a black official cap, a dark blue robe with leather armour on the shoulders; steady, trusting expression.
items.emperor: Emperor Xian as a boy of eight, small and composed, with bright intelligent eyes, wearing a small black imperial cap and a black robe with yellow trim; a serious, calm expression beyond his age.
items.sunjian: Sun Jian, a bold southern general in his mid-thirties, strong and fierce-eyed, with a short black beard, a red headscarf under a bronze helmet, red-and-bronze lamellar armour; brave, decisive expression.
items.sunce: Sun Ce at sixteen, a handsome, spirited teenage boy with bright determined eyes, hair in a topknot with a red band, a plain dark-red robe with a leather armour collar; grieving but resolute.
items.sunquan: Sun Quan as a boy of nine, sturdy with a square jaw, unusual blue-green eyes and reddish-brown hair in a small topknot, a dark red robe; calm, watchful expression beyond his age.
items.wangyun: Wang Yun, an elderly Han minister of about sixty, thin and dignified, with a long grey beard, a tall black official cap and a dark-blue court robe; grave, scheming, determined eyes.
items.diaochan: Diaochan, a beautiful young Han-dynasty woman of about eighteen, graceful, with an elegant high hairstyle with simple hairpins, a pale rose silk robe with wide sleeves; gentle but secretly resolute expression.
items.huaxiong: Hua Xiong, a towering, fierce general serving Dong Zhuo, with a broad scarred face, a thick black beard, dark iron armour and a helmet with a red plume; arrogant, intimidating glare.
items.lvboshe: Lü Boshe, a kindly elderly country gentleman of about sixty, round friendly face, white beard, a simple brown cloth cap and a plain brown robe; warm, welcoming smile.
items.yuanshu: Yuan Shu, a proud aristocratic warlord in his thirties, with a well-groomed short beard, a lavish gold-embroidered purple robe and a jewelled black cap; vain, ambitious, haughty look.
items.liubiao: Liu Biao, the governor of Jing province, a tall, refined scholar-official in his fifties, with a neat greying beard, a black official cap and an elegant dark-green robe; cautious, scholarly expression.
items.huangzu: Huang Zu, a hard-faced middle-aged general of Jing province, with a heavy black moustache, dark leather armour over a green robe and a simple helmet; cold, watchful expression.
items.yuanshao: Yuan Shao, the leader of the allied warlords, a handsome, imposing noble in his late thirties with a full well-kept beard, a black official cap and a rich dark-red robe under a fine armoured cape; proud, commanding look.
